title: Monotonicity of noise sensitivity
statement: For every Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, its noise-sensitivity curve is monotone on $[0,1/2]$: whenever $0\le \delta_1\le\delta_2\le 1/2$, the noise sensitivity at $\delta_1$ is at most that at $\delta_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
